description: This file defines a composable function HomeScreen that provides the scaffolding for an Android TV application's home screen interface using Jetpack Compose. It manages focus navigation between header, hero section, and content rails, establishing a focus model for a seamless D-Pad navigation experience.

classes.name: HeroItem
classes.description: Represents a hero item on the home screen, likely containing media or promotional content.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: Defines a navigation item in the header menu.

classes.name: RailSection
classes.description: Represents a section of content rails displayed below the hero.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Defines the main composable function for the Android TV home screen interface, setting up focus traversal and layout.
